newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish air cargo traffic up 8.5pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Spanish air cargo traffic up 8.5pct in October.

text.p: Air cargo traffic at the 39 airports managed by AENA (Spanish Airports and Air Navigation), rose 8.5 percent in October compared with the same month a year ago, AENA said.

Of the total 45,383 tonnes of cargo that passed through Spanish airports last month, international traffic made up 25,345 tonnes, up 9.4 percent, and domestic traffic 20,038 tonnes, an increase of 7.4 percent.
The accumulated total for the first 10 months of the year now stands at 401,033 tonnes, 8.8 percent higher than 1995.

Passenger numbers were 4.3 percent higher at 9.38 million, taking the total to 89.32 million so far this year, 4.9 percent ahead of last year. International scheduled passenger traffic has shown the fastest growth so far this year, rising 24 percent, and national charter traffic in the sharpest fall, down 14.1 percent. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
